mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS drug_id, d.drug_code, d.drug_name, d.low_stock_threshold, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity - i.locked_quantity), 0) AS available_quantity FROM drug d LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.drug_id = d.id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.enabled = 1 GROUP BY d.id, d.drug_code, d.drug_name, d.low_stock_threshold HAVING COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity - i.locked_quantity), 0) < d.low_stock_threshold ORDER BY available_quantity ASC, d.id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT d.id FROM drug d LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.drug_id = d.id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.enabled = 1 GROUP BY d.id, d.low_stock_threshold HAVING COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity - i.locked_quantity), 0) < d.low_stock_threshold ) t

SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, d.id AS drug_id, d.drug_code, d.drug_name, i.batch_no, i.expiry_date, i.quantity, DATEDIFF(i.expiry_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS days_to_expiry, CASE WHEN i.expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'EXPIRY' END AS warning_type FROM inventory i INNER JOIN drug d ON d.id = i.drug_id WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0 AND i.quantity > 0 AND ( i.expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE OR DATEDIFF(i.expiry_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= #{expiryDays} ) ORDER BY i.expiry_date ASC, i.id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM inventory i INNER JOIN drug d ON d.id = i.drug_id WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0 AND i.quantity > 0 AND ( i.expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE OR DATEDIFF(i.expiry_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= #{expiryDays} )
